parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, typically made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, and designed to cover the pen tip.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping it on.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, cylindrical, and houses the ink refill and writing tip.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main structure for holding the ink cartridge and provides grip for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, but the internal ink refill may move slightly when replaced.
